name.en: Purifire of the Winter Raven's Forest
name.ja: <ruby>白<rt>はく</rt></ruby><ruby>鴉<rt>あ</rt></ruby>の<ruby>森<rt>もり</rt></ruby>の<ruby>炎<rt>えん</rt></ruby><ruby>魔<rt>ま</rt></ruby>

text.en: If you control a "Winter Raven" card, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Purifire of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Purifire of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Winter Raven" Spell/Trap or 1 "Sinful Spoils" card from your Deck to your hand. You can target 1 "Winter Raven" Monster Card or 1 Level 7 or 8 Monster Card in the Spell & Trap Zone; Special Summon it to your field.
text.zh-CN: 此卡名以①方法的特殊召唤1回合仅可进行1次，且②③效果1回合仅可各使用1次。①：自己场上存在“白鸦”卡的情况下，此卡可从手牌特殊召唤。②：此卡召唤・特殊召唤的情况下可以发动。从牌组将1张“白鸦”魔法・陷阱卡或“罪宝”卡加入手牌。③：以自己或对手的魔法与陷阱区域的1张“白鸦”怪兽卡或等级7・8的怪兽卡为对象可以发动。将该卡特殊召唤至自己场上。
